files.namespace.sh:
set -euo pipefail
r=/workspace/voxl-stun-startup-c7eb4dc
export XTABLES_LOCKFILE=/tmp/voxl-stun-c7eb4dc-${BASHPID}.lock
printf '%s\n' "$XTABLES_LOCKFILE" > "$r/xtables-lock-path.log"
trap 'rm -f "$XTABLES_LOCKFILE"' EXIT
ip link set lo multicast on up
ip route add 224.0.0.0/4 dev lo
ip addr add 127.0.0.2/32 dev lo
ip addr add 127.0.0.3/32 dev lo
ip addr add 127.0.0.10/32 dev lo
ip route replace local 127.0.0.10/32 dev lo src 127.0.0.2 table local
iptables -A INPUT -p udp -s 127.0.0.2/31 -d 127.0.0.2/31 -j DROP
set +e
python3 "$r/fixture.py"
c=$?
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
text=subprocess.check_output(['iptables','-L','INPUT','-v','-n','-x'],text=True)
rows=[line.split() for line in text.splitlines() if 'DROP' in line]
Path('/workspace/voxl-stun-startup-c7eb4dc/firewall-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'drop_packets':sum(int(x[0]) for x in rows),'drop_bytes':sum(int(x[1]) for x in rows),'rule_count':len(rows)},indent=2)+'\n')
PY
exit "$c"
